name: KING GHIDORAH
about: The C example KING GHIDORAH rebuilt in blocks, three stages deep. Powerline hits in one ball start it (each powerline twice, four times the second time, six times the third). THE HEADS is the C's battle: only the lit head (two shots each, lit gold and named on the line) takes damage, it turns, a wounded head grows back, each sever pays into the pot; THE WINGS: hit the Big loop and the Mecha lane in turn to ground him; THE FINAL BLOW: the Maser's super jackpot and the pot twice over. Cash the pot at the right scoop once the heads are off; failing pays a quarter.
lost: The heads' shots have no 250 ms debounce: a ball rattling on a target is several hits (the C counted one hit a quarter second per shot).
A start from the tab's Start mode now counts as the ball's and the game's start too (the C counted only the three powerlines).
When a run will not count (it already ran this ball) the powerlines say nothing; the C logged why once. The C ran at most twice a game; the blocks any number of times, each start costing more.

The HUD shows a severed head's health as 0, where the C showed X; in the final blow the counters are the POT, the SUPER JACKPOT and the STAGE, where the C hid all but the super jackpot; and the gauge counts the stages, where the C's counted the severed heads.

Awards say their numbers under the words: LEFT HEAD over 5,000,000  -  SEVERED  +10 SECONDS, where the C said LEFT HEAD SEVERED over 5,000,000   +10 SECONDS; a head growing back says LEFT HEAD over GROWS BACK, where the C said LEFT HEAD REGROWS. A hit on the lit head says AGAIN: and its two shots under LEFT HEAD -2, where the C said the points; a glancing blow names the lit head's two shots (NOW: BUILDING OR CENTER POWERLINE), where the C named the head. Every note stays 3 s at least, where the C showed a hit's 1.3 s, a glancing blow's 1.2 s and a head growing back 1.8 s.
The HUD's line names the lit head's two shots (SHOOT THE LEFT RAMP OR LEFT POWERLINE), where the C said SHOOT THE LEFT HEAD.

The lit head turns every 14 s (12 s the second time, 10 s the third) and a wound grows back after 28 s (24 s, 20 s), where the C turned it every 8 s and grew a wound back after 10 s (PAD-658: a moving target stays 10 s at least, a window 20 s). A wounded head that is not lit stays dark, where the C pulsed it green: only the lit head takes damage, so only its shots are lit.
The ending title (GHIDORAH DEFEATED, GHIDORAH FLEES or GHIDORAH ESCAPES) and its total stay up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept them 10 s, with KING GHIDORAH TOTAL under the total.
The lit head moves on its own timer, and moves a tick after a sever (the C moved it in the same tick); its inserts change a tick after a hit too.
The countdown's 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 callouts are gone (the blocks say only ten seconds and time up).

Godzilla Premium/LE and Pro 1.16 only (a Pro 1.15 has no switch shots): the C also ran on a Pro 1.15. It played the game's Strobe burst at the start and Colour fade at the end, with its own shows where the game had none; the blocks run its own shows (Ghidorah start, Ghidorah won, Ghidorah lost and six more) on every title instead.

The blocks pack keeps its own FINAL WARS ledger in shared variables ('ghidorah played', 'ghidorah won'), which the blocks FINAL WARS reads: the C FINAL WARS does not read them, and the blocks FINAL WARS does not read the C's ledger.

intro.what: Ghidorah's birth: the flaming shape in a dark blue sky resolves into the golden three-headed dragon, wings spread (one continuous shot)

loop.what: Night, Yokohama in flames: Ghidorah's golden necks weave among burning buildings and power lines, dark orange, starts and ends on necks among flames

sever.what: Godzilla fires his atomic ray; it slams into Ghidorah's neck in a burst of light and sparks

regrow.what: GMK: Ghidorah re-forms in golden light over the city, wings sweeping up and the three heads rearing

won.what: Godzilla fires his atomic ray; it blasts Ghidorah's wing to pieces and Ghidorah tumbles out of the sky

lost.what: Ghidorah's lightning blasts Godzilla off his feet into smoke, then the three heads fire again

wings.what: Run of two shots on Planet X: King Ghidorah's necks rise out of the smoke and he lifts off past the camera with his wings beating, then soars up overhead with all three heads and both wings spread, at 0:50:12.

wing.what: Run of three shots: missiles from the fighter jets burst against King Ghidorah's wing and flank as he flies, a jet streaks past, then another missile bursts under his wing and he trails smoke, at 1:06:17.

fall.what: King Ghidorah, thrown off the seaside cliff and wrapped in Mothra's silk, crashes down at its foot in a cloud of dust with his golden wings flailing as a boulder strikes him, at 1:29:24.

final.what: At the foot of Mt. Fuji the downed King Ghidorah's heads thrash low in the dirt as Godzilla grabs a neck and the allied monsters close in for the finish, at 1:18:53.

cashout.what: Beaten, King Ghidorah lifts off the mountainside and flies away over the ridge into the open sky, seen from behind, at 1:29:40.

music.what: Akira Ifukube's score, Planet X (bed finder: final 0.833, loop chroma 0.82, 0 untuned blocks)

sever.what: Ghidorah's shriek in the final battle at Mt. Fuji (the game's own Ghidorah screech matches 0.74; a pulsed trill clear of music)

won.what: Godzilla's roar in the final fight (harmonic roar cpp 0.38)

lost.what: Ghidorah flying off at the end (the game's own Ghidorah flying matches 0.97)

regrow.what: Ghidorah's trilling cackle in the final battle (the game's own Ghidorah screech matches 0.84; the clearest trill, a 6 dB step at its start)

summon.what: King Ghidorah's shrill pulsing cackle, two bursts, as he flies in over the snowy peak of Mt. Fuji, at 1:14:42.

wing.what: A rushing whoosh as King Ghidorah's wings sweep over the city and his shadow passes over the crowd below, at 1:08:38.

fall.what: A heavy crash and rumble as King Ghidorah, thrown off the cliff, hits the ground below while Godzilla watches from the top, at 1:29:21.

cashout.what: King Ghidorah's trilling cackle breaking off and fading as he flies away from Planet X into the dark sky, at 0:50:21.

final.what: Kow Otani's driving main title theme under the opening credits, no dialogue (bed finder final 0.842, seam chroma 0.847), at 0:04:26.
